profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at PNC
profile.summary:
A talented Software Engineer with extensive hands-on experience in multiple industries. Repeatedly obtains success through collaboration with cross-functional teams in the design, development, testing and launch of leading-edge technology solutions and business process improvements. Simultaneously manages multiple projects. Is eager to learn and apply new technologies. A professional who demonstrates integrity on a personal and professional level in addition to possessing exceptional team values to produce quality results.

Specialties: Java Technologies
